853:t_27:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I know it's a borrowed name. But to me and everyone else, you're $$トロワ・バートン$$ and no one else.」

853:t_27:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all... I know full well how important a name is.」

853:t_28:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Knowing you, $$カトル$$, I'd imagine your life has always been blessed, but...」

853:t_28:6.en:
$$カトル$$
「But now I'm separated from my family, though my friends are here for me instead...」

853:t_28:7.en:
$$カトル$$
「Of course, $$ＡＧ$$... You're one of them too.」

853:t_28:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for those undeservedly kind words. They make me want to join the $$マグアナック隊$$ too.」

853:t_28:9.en:
$$カトル$$
「In your case, you should have $$ラシード$$ train your mind.」

853:t_28:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You speak harsh words with such a kind face... You really are no ordinary person, $$カトル$$...」

853:t_29:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How about a friendly game of mahjong to celebrate becoming an ace? $$アルト$$ is an easy target right now.」

853:t_29:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「Why are you bringing up mahjong? And why are you bringing $$アルト$$ into it?」

853:t_29:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm so glad I made you laugh! You're so damned serious that you never react to this sort of thing.」

853:t_29:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... If you're doing it willingly, I won't complain quite so much.」

853:t_29:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... It seems I've gotten too carried away...」

853:t_30:4.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I never thought anyone would congratulate me.」

853:t_30:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I've said before, if you take belittling yourself too far, it becomes ridiculous.」

853:t_30:6.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「You're right. I'll just let myself enjoy this.」

853:t_30:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You don't look happy at all! Please express your joy with your whole body!」

853:t_30:8.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「How should I express my joy?」

853:t_30:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You could dance with a big smile and make strange cries. That would be perfect.」

853:t_30:10.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'm an awkward man. I don't quite understand, so could you show me an example?」

853:t_30:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh... It seems breaking down a handsome man's defenses isn't easy...」

853:t_31:4.en:
$$ノイン$$
「If you come any closer, I'll shoot!」

853:t_31:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You warned me right off the bat!」

853:t_31:6.en:
$$ノイン$$
「It wasn't sudden. I've told you time and again to stay away from $$ゼクス$$ and me.」

853:t_31:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「T-that's cruel, when I'm here to congratulate you...」

853:t_31:8.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I've seen you do it before: appeal to someone's sympathy, then sexually harass them when they let their guard down.」

853:t_31:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-you're just as sharp as I'd expect, $$ノイン$$...! I never knew you'd seen through me so completely...!」

853:t_31:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then what am I supposed to do?!」

853:t_31:14.en:
$$ノイン$$
「No means no, even if you lash out when you're at fault.」

853:t_32:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're so straightforward, $$ヒルデ$$. People like you really are...」

853:t_32:6.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Ah... If you come any closer, I'll shoot.」

853:t_32:8.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「$$ノイン$$ told me to be as wary of you as possible and not hesitate to use force.」

853:t_32:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I didn't realize another student trained by Instructor $$ノイン$$ was here...」

853:t_32:10.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Do you really want to sexually harass someone that badly?」

853:t_32:12.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Even if you say it with such a cheerful smile...」

853:t_32:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm just like that cheerful Grim Reaper you love so much, $$ヒルデ$$.」

853:t_33:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. You... don't seem as bad as everyone says.」

853:t_33:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course I'm not! Honesty is my selling point!」

853:t_33:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm in a great mood today! Come, let's invite $$ティファ$$ and have an ace pilot celebration!」

853:t_33:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sorry... On second thought, I'm not letting $$ティファ$$ anywhere near you.」

853:t_33:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm not a $$ニュータイプ$$, but I can only see this ending badly.」

853:t_33:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh... You don't trust me after all...」

853:t_34:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're one of the $$ムーンレィス$$, $$ロラン$$... And $$ムーンレィス$$ are people of the Moon... So I've prepared the perfect outfit.」

853:t_34:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Rabbits live on the Moon... And rabbits mean bunny girls. Come, hurry and get changed.」

853:t_34:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying? Come on... Hurry and show me the famous $$ローラ$$.」

853:t_34:10.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I-I'm $$ロラン$$! I'm not $$ローラ$$!!」

853:t_35:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$. But seriously... Stop being so formal with me.」

853:t_35:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... If you insist... Still, I can't quite bring myself to address a customer too casually...」

853:t_35:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, my... 'Bitter hardship', is it...? That really is a fitting name.」

853:t_35:9.en:
$$シン$$
「I-I don't know why, but I'm starting to feel really awful...」

853:t_35:10.en:
$$シン$$
「Are you... looking down on me?」

853:t_35:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm not. Even if you asked me, I'd never want to taste bitter hardship.」

853:t_35:12.en:
$$シン$$
「Forget it! I was an idiot to try to get along with you!」
